avoid: Invented copy, logos, or markings on props
Obscuring or altering visible product branding
Flags, landmarks, iconic wildlife, or costume shorthand
Terrace, plinth, and distant coastal horizon
concept: A graphic flat-lay still life with crisp summer shadows and generous space for the supplied copy.

context_cues.cue: Pale limestone and restrained coastal-heath foliage suggest a southern Australian coastal environment without a landmark.
Strong, warm light and dry botanical shadows evoke summer.

lighting.direction: low light from the upper right
lighting.quality: clear, warm sunlight with defined botanical shadows

palette: Black and dark gray from the sunglasses

product_placement.orientation: Slightly angled flat lay, with both lenses, silver-colored outer-corner accents, and curved arms leg

rationale: The central flat lay gives the sunglasses a clear silhouette while keeping all four text blocks in separate grid cells. Restrained material and lighting cues establish place and season without relying on stereotypes.
setting: A close-cropped studio surface inspired by the pale limestone and low coastal heath of southern Australia; no terrace, plinth, or horizon.
surface_and_props: A few small limestone fragments kept clear of the product
Sparse coastal-heath foliage at the outer edge of the frame
